achievements.name: Fifty down
achievements.tip: Dig 50 m below the landing pad level. Watch your oxygen budget on the way back up.

achievements.name: The first percent
achievements.tip: Clears naturally in the first few days once you start mining core veins and mount your first ship turret.

achievements.name: First month
achievements.tip: Simply start Day 30 on any save. Unlocks on a No Rush save as well as a normal contract.

achievements.name: Tithe
achievements.tip: 500,000 m³ excavated. Chain high-value veins and reinvest early in cheap ship guns like the Autocannon.

achievements.name: Straight to the heart
achievements.description: Reach the center of the asteroid.
achievements.tip: Bore inward through stone, deep stone, basalt and core metal. You'll want the Missile Swarm for core metal, and in new campaigns the very center is strange matter.

achievements.name: Quarter gone
achievements.description: Destroy a quarter of the asteroid.
achievements.tip: 1,250,000 m³ destroyed. A useful pace check: reaching 25% around Day 22–23 keeps you on a straight-line schedule for the 90-day contract.

achievements.name: Halfway there
achievements.tip: 2,500,000 m³ cleared. If you pass 50% around or before Day 45, automated ship scaling will carry your late game.

achievements.name: Apple core
achievements.description: Destroy three quarters of the asteroid.
achievements.tip: 3,750,000 m³ destroyed (1,250,000 m³ left). Usually arrives once ship guns are doing most of the volume.

achievements.name: A million by hand
achievements.description: Dig out 1,000,000 m³ without the ship's help.
achievements.tip: 1,000,000 m³ dug without ship guns counting. Handheld tools, drones and charges are your volume here—upgrade the Plasma Cutter or Missile Swarm and track it over a long run.

achievements.name: Home stretch
achievements.tip: 4,500,000 m³ cleared (500,000 m³ remaining). Heavy ship ordnance like Orbital Strike and Collapsar make quick work of the last 10%.

achievements.name: Earth saved
achievements.description: Grind the asteroid down to zero.
achievements.tip: Reduce remaining volume to 0 m³ before Earth impact to secure the full victory ending.

achievements.name: Two months, no days off
achievements.tip: Start Day 60. Pairs naturally with a full campaign run; check the calculator to see if your pace still finishes by Day 90.

achievements.name: Wide awake
achievements.description: Reach the end without ever blacking out.
achievements.tip: Always leave an oxygen safety margin for your return trip and board the lander before liftoff in co-op.

achievements.name: Complaints accepted
achievements.tip: Failure / partial-impact ending triggered when the 90-day timer expires with asteroid mass still remaining.

achievements.name: Something shiny
achievements.tip: Keep an eye out for non-ore relics embedded in rock pockets while tunneling.

achievements.name: Collector
achievements.tip: Deposit recovered relics at your ship's museum/observation dome to track progress.

achievements.name: Gifts of the deep
achievements.tip: Deep-interior relics found while pushing toward the asteroid core.

achievements.name: True fan
achievements.tip: Pop-culture Easter egg artifacts scattered across medium and deep excavation layers.

achievements.name: Paleontologist
achievements.tip: Collect all fossil exhibits buried inside the asteroid rock.

achievements.name: Someone will claim it
achievements.tip: Includes everyday satirical objects like office chairs and the empty safe labeled for defense budgets.

achievements.name: Online
achievements.tip: Relics tied to internet-era satire hidden inside asteroid strata.

achievements.name: Reel it in
achievements.tip: Grab a floating artifact drifting off into space after blasting open outer pockets.

achievements.name: Historian
achievements.tip: Includes satirical space-age relics such as orbital tapes and historical space items.

achievements.name: Finders keepers
achievements.tip: Watch for orbital debris and drifting finds around the asteroid exterior (pair with Tractor Beam).

achievements.name: Full museum
achievements.tip: Requires completing all 7 museum collections across surface, deep crust, core, and drifting space debris.

achievements.name: Quota met
achievements.description: Complete an order of the day.
achievements.tip: Check the terminal's daily order request and prioritize those specific ores for bonus income.

achievements.name: First paycheck
achievements.tip: Return to the lander with mined Space Ice or Meteoric Iron and sell it at the ship terminal.

achievements.name: Heavy argument
achievements.tip: Buy the Sledgehammer—usually your first tool upgrade.

achievements.name: Driller
achievements.tip: Buy the Drill.

achievements.name: Gun on the roof
achievements.description: Mount your first gun on the ship.
achievements.tip: Buy your first automated ship weapon early so your ship chips away at the asteroid while you tunnel.

achievements.name: Rocketeer
achievements.tip: Essential mobility upgrade for navigating vertical shafts and flying back to the lander quickly.

achievements.name: Employee of the month
achievements.tip: Complete 10 daily orders. Check the order of the day each morning and route your digging around it.

achievements.name: Little helper
achievements.tip: Buy any drone.

achievements.name: Ray of hope
achievements.tip: Buy the Laser.

achievements.name: Six figures
achievements.tip: Hold $100,000 in your wallet at the same moment—save up before a big purchase instead of spending every paycheck.

achievements.name: Fourth state of matter
achievements.tip: Buy the Plasma Cutter.

achievements.name: Mineralogist
achievements.tip: The achievement asks for eight minerals, while the game has 11 sellable ores. It isn't confirmed which eight count, so mine every ore type you come across—including deep Neutronium and Dark Matter.

achievements.name: Millionaire
achievements.tip: $1,000,000 earned across a single save (lifetime earnings, not cash on hand).

achievements.name: Multimillionaire
achievements.tip: $3,000,000 earned in one game. Comes naturally on a full 90-day run once high-value minerals are flowing.

achievements.name: Beehive
achievements.tip: Buy the Missile Swarm, the top handheld tool.

achievements.name: Squadron
achievements.description: Buy all four kinds of drones.
achievements.tip: Own all four drone types.

achievements.name: Armed to the teeth
achievements.tip: Unlock all 6 ship slots—slots 2–6 cost about $869,000 in total.

achievements.name: Full toolbox
achievements.tip: Buy all 8 tools: Pickaxe, Sledgehammer, Drill, Laser, Plasma Cutter, Missile Swarm, Lance and Slicer. The last two only appear after you own an Orbital Strike or Collapsar (or hit core metal).

achievements.name: Overtime
achievements.description: After the ending, take a contract on a new asteroid.
achievements.tip: Finish a contract, then accept the new-asteroid contract offered after the ending.

achievements.name: Demolition expert
achievements.description: Use all five charges from the workshop.
achievements.tip: Use all five charges available from the workshop. One of the rarer gear achievements (~24%), so don't hoard them.

achievements.name: On a roll
achievements.tip: Push the mining combo multiplier to ×1.5 by breaking rock continuously without long pauses.

achievements.name: Government property
achievements.tip: Strike the landing pad structure on the asteroid surface with your tool or ship fire.

achievements.name: Gas!
achievements.tip: Watch for pressurized gas pockets inside deep tunnels; breaching one unlocks this achievement.

achievements.name: On a leash
achievements.description: Get pulled back to the lander by the tether.
achievements.tip: Get reeled back to the lander by the safety tether. Nearly 90% of players earn it during normal play.

achievements.name: Seen it all
achievements.description: Catch a meteor shower, a solar flare and a vein.
achievements.tip: Witness a meteor shower, a solar flare and a vein event—they arrive over the course of a normal campaign.

achievements.name: Boom
achievements.tip: Deep-core Antimatter pockets detonate on impact—approach carefully or trigger intentionally when clear.

achievements.name: Low orbit
achievements.description: Stay in the air for 15 seconds straight.
achievements.tip: Stay airborne for 15 consecutive seconds—easiest with the jetpack in low gravity.

achievements.name: Nap time
achievements.tip: Run out of oxygen or fail to reach the lander before departure. Do this on a separate save if chasing 'Wide awake'.

achievements.name: Rock rider
achievements.description: Ride a loose piece of rock while it flies.
achievements.tip: Stand on a chunk of rock that has broken loose and ride it while it drifts.

achievements.name: Second wind
achievements.description: Keep going on the emergency ampoule.
achievements.tip: Keep working on the emergency ampoule rather than heading straight back. Rare (~11%) because most players retreat first—try it close to the lander.

achievements.name: Coffee break
achievements.description: Have a coffee before a shift.
achievements.tip: Explore the mothership interior before dropping down to the lander and interact with the coffee station.

achievements.name: Zero-g
achievements.tip: Switch off the ship's gravity.

achievements.name: Hot lunch
achievements.description: Heat up a ration in the microwave.
achievements.tip: Heat a ration in the microwave.

achievements.name: Fresh off the line
achievements.tip: Wash the lander until it's completely clean.

achievements.name: Can I drive?
achievements.tip: Sit in a pilot's seat.

achievements.name: One more game
achievements.description: Finish a game on the canteen computer.
achievements.tip: Finish a game on the canteen computer.

achievements.name: Five-dollar massage
achievements.description: Turn on the massage in the dome chair.
achievements.tip: Sit in the dome chair and switch on its massage function.

achievements.name: Bets are open
achievements.description: See every place on Earth through the telescope.
achievements.tip: Use the telescope and look at every place on Earth it can show. Easy to miss (~27%).

achievements.name: Lights out
achievements.tip: Sleep in the bed. Only ~20% of players have it—most never try the bed.

achievements.name: Not in the plan
achievements.tip: Hidden achievement: start the ship's self-destruct. Use a spare save slot if you're nervous.

museumCollections.name: Lost and found
museumCollections.focus: Misplaced everyday items (office chairs, empty defense-budget safe)

museumCollections.name: From the depths
museumCollections.focus: Deep-interior mysteries near the asteroid core

museumCollections.name: Dinosaurs tried too
museumCollections.focus: Prehistoric fossils embedded in the rock
